entries.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
likely_causes: Long-running or slow queries holding connections open
Underlying database instance is unreachable or overloaded
Pool size misconfigured for current traffic
recommended_actions: Check database instance health and network reachability
Inspect slow query logs for the affected service
Temporarily increase pool size or restart the connection pool
Failover to a standby database instance if available

entries.title: Downstream service errors from a failing dependency
likely_causes: A dependency the service calls is degraded or unavailable
Retries without backoff amplifying load on the failing dependency
recommended_actions: Identify which dependency is failing using service status data
Check if circuit breakers or graceful degradation are active
Verify retry policies are not overwhelming the downstream service

entries.title: Elevated latency without elevated error rate
likely_causes: Garbage collection pauses or resource contention
recommended_actions: Compare current request volume against baseline
Check host-level CPU and memory metrics
Review recent deploys for performance regressions
